title: Ethereum as a Relative Asset-Pricing Problem Across Numeraires: Baseline Evidence from Triangular Pricing Consistency
abstract: arXiv:2611.27989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies Ethereum pricing as a relative asset-pricing problem across numeraires. The core restriction is triangular consistency among ETH/USD, ETH/BTC, and BTC/USD: the direct ETH/USD price should equal the synthetic price implied by the other two legs. Using a single-venue Coinbase true-USD triangle at hourly frequency from January 2022 through June 2023, I measure the log wedge between direct and synthetic prices. The wedge is close to zero on average, ADF diagnostics reject the unit-root null, and first-order persistence is low, while its absolute magnitude rises during stress episodes, especially around the FTX collapse. Supporting evidence from a Binance USDT triangle shows a tighter unconditional wedge, suggesting that venue liquidity and arbitrage efficiency also matter for wedge magnitudes in this sample. translated_title: 以太坊作为跨计价单位的相对资产定价问题：来自三角定价一致性的基线证据
translated_abstract: 本文将以太坊定价视为一个跨计价单位的相对资产定价问题进行研究。其核心约束是 ETH/USD、ETH/BTC 与 BTC/USD 之间的三角一致性：直接的 ETH/USD 价格应等于由另外两个交易对所隐含的合成价格。作者使用 2022 年 1 月至 2023 年 6 月期间 Coinbase 单一交易场所的真实美元三角数据（小时频率），测量了直接价格与合成价格之间的对数楔形差。结果表明该楔形差平均接近于零，ADF 检验拒绝了单位根原假设，一阶持续性较低，但其绝对幅度在压力时期会上升，尤其是在 FTX 崩溃前后。来自 Binance USDT 三角的辅助证据显示无条件楔形差更为紧缩，这表明在该样本中，交易场所的流动性与套利效率对楔形差的大小同样重要。针对 Terra/Luna、FTX 和 USDC-SVB 事件窗口的 Gate.io 订单簿扩展分析使用每小时的买卖报价快照来进行……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过检验 ETH/USD、ETH/BTC 与 BTC/USD 三角定价一致性，发现直接价格与合成价格间的偏差平均接近于零且平稳，但在 FTX 崩溃等压力时期会扩大，且交易场所的流动性与套利效率也影响偏差大小。
en_tdlr: This paper tests triangular pricing consistency among ETH/USD, ETH/BTC, and BTC/USD, showing that the wedge between direct and synthetic ETH prices is near zero on average and stationary, but widens during stress episodes such as the FTX collapse, with venue liquidity and arbitrage efficiency also shaping wedge magnitudes.
